decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The building hereby permitted shall be removed and the land restored to its former condition on or before 30th June 2006.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access tothe classroom shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 6 - This permission is granted only in acknowledgement of the special circumstances of this use and only for a limited period.  Any proposal for permanent replacement accommodation will be considered on its merits and should form part of a long-term programme for meeting the future needs of the school.  This should be drawn up in consultation with the Borough Planning Service and should take account of the site's Green Belt status.
description: Installation of 1 x double mobile classroom to existing school.
